title: Big Bore Natural Gas Engine Engineer
locationsText: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US
locations: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US
description:
Weichai America is seeking an experienced Big Bore Natural Gas Engine Engineer to support the development of next-generation power generation technologies. In this highly visible engineering role, you will lead the design, analysis, testing, and continuous improvement of large-bore natural gas engines, helping deliver reliable, efficient, and environmentally responsible power solutions. Working with a collaborative team of engineers and technical experts, you will contribute to innovative products that serve customers across the industrial, energy, and power generation markets.

Position Summary

The Big Bore Natural Gas Engine Engineer is responsible for the design, development, performance optimization, and technical support of large-displacement natural gas engines used in power generation, oil & gas, and industrial applications. The role covers engine performance, combustion, emissions compliance, durability, and field troubleshooting across stationery and mobile applications.

Key Responsibilities

Engine Design & Development

• Support design and development of large-bore natural gas engines and related subsystems.

• Optimize combustion performance, fuel efficiency, and emissions compliance.

• Develop improvements for reliability, durability, and service life.

• Collaborate with mechanical, controls, and electrical teams for system integration.

Performance & Emissions Optimization

• Analyze engine performance data to improve efficiency and output.

• Support emissions compliance for NOx, CO, VOC, and methane slip regulations.

• Work on combustion tuning and control calibration.

Testing & Validation

• Plan and execute engine test programs.

• Analyze test results and recommend design or calibration changes.

• Support prototype and validation testing.

Field Support & Troubleshooting

• Provide technical support for field issues and root-cause investigations.

• Support commissioning and troubleshooting of engines in customer installations.

• Work with service teams to improve engine reliability and maintainability.

System Integration

• Support integration with:

• Generator systems

• Fuel systems

• Cooling and lubrication systems

• Aftertreatment systems

• Control and monitoring systems

Documentation & Compliance

• Prepare technical reports and documentation.

• Support regulatory compliance and certification activities.

• Support customer and internal technical reviews.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

• Experience with large natural gas engines or industrial combustion systems.

• Knowledge of internal combustion engine operation and thermodynamics.

• Experience in engine testing and data analysis.

• Familiarity with emissions regulations and engine controls.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with big bore engines.

• Experience in power generation or oil & gas engine applications.

• Knowledge of combustion simulation or engine modeling tools.

• Experience with calibration and engine control systems.

• Field commissioning or service experience.

Key Skills

• Engine performance analysis

• Combustion & emissions knowledge

• Test data interpretation

• Root cause analysis

• Cross-functional teamwork

• Technical documentation

• Project execution

Typical Applications Supported

• Natural gas generator sets

• Industrial power engines

• Data center backup generation

Benefits

Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, STD and LTD, HSA and FSA options, 401(k) with company match.

title: Electrical Engineer Power Grid & Data Center Infrastructure
locationsText: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US
locations: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US
description:
Join Weichai America and help power the future of critical infrastructure! We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to design and develop advanced power systems supporting utility grids, industrial facilities, and next-generation data centers. This is an exciting opportunity to work on complex electrical infrastructure projects involving substations, switchgear, UPS systems, backup generation, and high-availability power distribution while collaborating with a talented engineering team to deliver innovative, reliable, and sustainable energy solutions.

Position Summary

The Electrical Engineer – Power Grid & Data Center Infrastructure is responsible for the design, analysis, integration, and commissioning of electrical power systems supporting utility grids, industrial facilities, and mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role provides technical leadership throughout the engineering lifecycle, from concept development and detailed design through installation, commissioning, and operational support.

The ideal candidate has experience with medium- and high-voltage power systems, electrical protection, data center infrastructure, and utility-scale electrical engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Power System Engineering

• Design, analyze, and optimize medium- and high-voltage electrical distribution systems.

• Develop single-line diagrams, electrical layouts, equipment specifications, and engineering documentation.

• Participate in the design of substations, transformers, switchgear, and distribution equipment.

• Support utility interconnection and power distribution projects.

Data Center Infrastructure

• Design and evaluate electrical infrastructure for mission-critical data centers, including:

• Utility service connections

• Substations and transformers

• Switchgear and busway systems

• UPS and battery energy storage systems

• Backup generation systems

• Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

• Develop resilient electrical architectures that support high-availability configurations such as N+1 and 2N redundancy.

System Analysis & Performance

• Perform electrical engineering studies, including:

• Load flow analysis

• Short-circuit analysis

• Protection coordination

• Arc flash studies

• Power quality assessments

• Recommend solutions that improve system reliability, efficiency, safety, and operational performance.

Grid Integration & Commissioning

• Coordinate with utility providers to ensure successful grid interconnections and regulatory compliance.

• Participate in renewable energy, distributed generation, and microgrid integration projects.

• Assist with commissioning, startup activities, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational support for electrical systems.

Compliance & Documentation

• Ensure designs comply with applicable electrical codes, industry standards, and safety requirements.

• Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, and permitting documentation.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

• Experience designing electrical power distribution systems for utility, industrial, or mission-critical facilities.

• Knowledge of medium- and high-voltage equipment, protective relays, and electrical protection systems.

• Experience using electrical modeling and simulation software.

• Strong understanding of applicable electrical codes and industry standards.

• Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.job codesbenefits

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience designing electrical infrastructure for data centers or other mission-critical facilities.

• Experience with utility-scale power generation, renewable energy, or microgrid systems.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure.

• Experience supporting commissioning, field engineering, or startup activities.

• Familiarity with battery energy storage systems (BESS) and backup power generation.

Core Competencies

• Electrical Power System Design

• Data Center Infrastructure

• Grid Integration

• Protection & Coordination Studies

• Power System Analysis

• Technical Documentation

• Project Execution

• Continuous Improvement

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Problem Solving

Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, STD and LTD, HSA and FSA options, and a 401(k) plan with company match.

title: Product Manager, Lean Burn Gas Power Generation
description:
Remote Work: This position is fully remote within the United States.

Join Weichai America and help shape the future of sustainable, reliable power generation. As a global leader in advanced engine and energy solutions, we are seeking an experienced Product Manager, Lean Burn Gas Power Generation, drive the growth and market development of our natural gas engine and generator product portfolio across North America.

As Weichai America continues to expand its presence in the North American power generation market, this role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of advanced lean-burn gas engine technologies while working alongside global engineering experts.

While the position is administratively based in our Rolling Meadows, Illinois office, the selected candidate may work remotely from anywhere within the United States.

In this highly collaborative role, you will manage product lifecycle activities, support regional market development initiatives, and serve as the key liaison between North American customers and our global engineering teams. Working at the intersection of engineering, technology, and business strategy, you will help influence product positioning, support new product introductions, gather customer insights, and drive continuous product improvement for our lean-burn gas engine and genset portfolio.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical understanding of lean-burn gas engines and power generation systems, combined with commercial awareness and the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional and international teams. If you are passionate about power generation technology, enjoy solving complex technical and commercial challenges, and want to make a meaningful impact within a growing global organization, we invite you to join our team.

Work Schedule

• Full-time, exempt position

• Fully remote within the United States

• Monday through Friday during standard business hours

• Approximately 15–20% domestic and international travel required for customer visits, industry events, and collaboration with global engineering and product teams

Key Responsibilities

• Support the development and execution of product strategies for lean-burn gas engines and gensets used in power generation applications, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and regional market needs.

• Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify industry trends, customer requirements, and growth opportunities to support product positioning and future development initiatives.

• Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and global product teams to support the development and enhancement of lean-burn gas engine and genset products, with a focus on performance, reliability, serviceability, and regulatory compliance.

• Work closely with sales, marketing, operations, and service teams to support product launches, customer engagement activities, technical support initiatives, and ongoing market development efforts.

• Gather and communicate customer and distributor feedback to internal stakeholders to support continuous product improvement and market responsiveness.

• Provide product training and technical support to sales teams, channel partners, and customers to enhance product knowledge and commercial effectiveness.

• Monitor product performance, customer feedback, and market response using established KPIs and reporting metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Support cross-functional coordination between North American operations and global engineering teams regarding product requirements, technical discussions, and market needs.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related technical field required. Advanced degree is a plus.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, applications engineering, business development, sales engineering, or related roles within the power generation, industrial engine, or energy industry.

• Demonstrated experience working with lean-burn gas engines, gaseous-fueled power generation systems, gensets, or related industrial energy technologies.

• Strong understanding of power generation systems, engine technologies, emissions considerations, and applicable industry standards.

• Proven ability to analyze market data, identify trends, and support strategic business decisions based on market and customer insights.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across cross-functional and international teams and influence stakeholders in a matrixed organizational environment.

• Proficiency with project management tools, product lifecycle management systems, and Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong business acumen with a customer-focused and market-driven approach.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 15–20% as business needs require.

• Ability to communicate in Mandarin is considered an asset due to regular interaction with engineering and product teams based in Weifang, China.

Benefits

Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, STD and LTD, HSA and FSA options, 401(k) with company match.

title: Project Manager-Electric Power Solutions
locationsText: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US

description:
Job Title: Project Manager – Electric Power Solutions

Location: Rolling Meadows, IL

Reports to: Director of Sales, NA

Salary: $90,000 - $120,000 annually

Type: Full-time, Permanent, Onsite

Join Weichai America and help deliver the next generation of mission-critical power solutions. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – Electric Power Generation to lead the execution of packaged generator system projects supporting data centers, industrial facilities, utilities, and other critical infrastructure throughout North America.

In this highly collaborative role, you will manage projects from customer order through commissioning and final turnover, coordinating engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, installation, and field service activities. Working closely with customers, suppliers, and global engineering teams, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management skills with technical knowledge of electrical power generation systems and enjoys leading complex projects in a fast-paced, growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management

• Manage multiple power generation projects from order acceptance through commissioning and customer handoff.

• Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, milestones, and resource plans.

• Monitor project scope and manage changes while minimizing cost and schedule impacts.

• Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure successful delivery.

• Provide regular project updates to customers and internal leadership.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate activities between customers, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, logistics, service, and external suppliers.

• Build strong customer relationships by proactively communicating project status and resolving issues.

Technical Coordination

• Review customer specifications and technical documentation to ensure compliance with project requirements.

• Coordinate engineering submittals, drawing approvals, equipment releases, and design changes.

• Support technical discussions involving generator systems, switchgear, controls, emissions systems, and balance-of-plant equipment.

Procurement & Project Execution

• Coordinate procurement and delivery of major project equipment.

• Monitor supplier performance, production schedules, and delivery milestones.

• Work with logistics teams to ensure equipment arrives on schedule.

• Support installation planning and site readiness activities.

Commissioning & Closeout

• Coordinate installation, startup, testing, and commissioning activities.

• Support field service teams in resolving technical and schedule-related issues.

• Ensure customer acceptance testing is successfully completed.

• Deliver project closeout documentation, including operation manuals, warranty information, and as-built documentation.

Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to improvements in project management processes and execution standards.

• Support the development of best practices for scheduling, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related technical field.

• PMP certification is preferred but not required.

Experience

• 3+ years of project management experience supporting electrical infrastructure, power generation, industrial equipment, or mission-critical facilities.

• Experience managing technically complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.

• Experience supporting generator systems, electrical distribution equipment, switchgear, or similar industrial systems is preferred.

• Data center or mission-critical infrastructure experience is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

• Understanding of electrical and mechanical power generation systems.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, electrical one-line diagrams, specifications, and project documentation.

• Familiarity with applicable industry standards such as NEC, NFPA, UL, IEC, NEMA, or ASME is preferred.

Skills

• Excellent project planning and organizational skills

• Strong leadership and relationship-building abilities

• Outstanding verbal and written communication

• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Budget and schedule management experience

• Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Excel, Word, and related project management tools

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Travel

• Ability to travel domestically up to 50% to customer sites, suppliers, and project locations.

Why Join Weichai America?

As Weichai America continues expanding its presence in the North American power generation and data center markets, you'll have the opportunity to lead projects that support some of the world's most critical infrastructure. You'll work alongside experienced engineering, manufacturing, and service professionals while helping deliver innovative, high-performance power solutions to customers across the continent.

locationsText: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US

description:
Job Title: Generator Field Service Technician

Location: Northern Illinois/Wisconsin
Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Senior Service Manager

Salary: $38–$46/hour, non-exempt

Join Weichai America as a Generator Field Service Technician and play a critical role in keeping mission-critical power systems operating at peak performance. In this hands-on position, you will install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair industrial generators and power generation equipment at customer sites. If you enjoy solving technical challenges, traveling to customer locations, and delivering exceptional service, this is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced power generation technologies while making a direct impact on customer success.

Position Summary

The Generator Field Service Technician is responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of Weichai Power natural gas generator systems at customer sites in Wisconsin. This role supports mission-critical and continuous power applications, including data centers and industrial facilities, ensuring optimal system performance, reliability, and compliance with safety and emissions standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Install, commission, and start up Weichai natural gas generator sets, including system integration with switchgear, controls, and facility infrastructure.

• Perform preventive maintenance and corrective repairs on gas engines, alternators, fuel systems, and emissions control components.

• Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control system issues using OEM diagnostic tools, software, and technical documentation.

• Conduct performance testing, synchronization, and load bank testing to validate system output and reliability.

• Support commissioning and tuning of gas engines for optimal efficiency, emissions compliance, and performance.

• Inspect and maintain auxiliary systems, including cooling, lubrication, ignition, and fuel delivery systems.

• Interface with control systems, including PLCs, generator controllers, and remote monitoring platforms.

• Document service activities, commissioning reports, and maintenance records in accordance with company and customer requirements.

• Provide technical support and training to customers on operation and maintenance best practices.

• Collaborate with engineering and product support teams to resolve complex technical issues and provide field feedback for continuous product improvement.

• Ensure compliance with all safety protocols, environmental regulations, and company policies.

Requirements

• Must be authorized to work in the United States.

• Valid U.S. driver’s license and clean driving record.

• Ability to travel extensively within Illinois and Wisconsin, with flexibility for other regions as needed.

Qualifications

• Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Technology, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

• 3–7+ years of field service experience with gas engines, power generation equipment, or distributed energy systems.

• Strong working knowledge of natural gas engine operation, combustion principles, and generator system components.

• Experience with electrical systems (low and medium voltage), control systems, and engine management systems.

• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, P&IDs, and technical manuals.

• Proficiency with diagnostic software and troubleshooting tools.

• Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively (regional and national).

• Ability to support on-call or emergency services for critical power applications.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with Weichai or comparable high-speed natural gas generator platforms (e.g., Jenbacher, MWM, CAT gas engines).

• Experience supporting data center backup or prime power systems and other mission-critical environments.

• Familiarity with emissions compliance, engine tuning, and air-fuel ratio control systems.

• OEM certifications or factory training on gas generator systems.

• Knowledge of paralleling switchgear and microgrid or distributed energy applications.

Professional Attributes

• Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis

• Strong customer-facing and communication skills

• Ability to work independently in field environments with minimal supervision

• High attention to safety, quality, and reliability

• Adaptability in fast-paced, high-growth technical environments

Benefits

Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, STD and LTD, HSA and FSA options, 401(k) with company match.

title: Field Service Engineer
locationsText: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US
locations: Weichai America Corp., Rolling Meadows, IL, US
description:
Field Service Engineer – Industrial Power Systems

Company: Weichai America Corp
Location: Illinois or Wisconsin (preferred)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Head of Customer Support – North America

Salary: $85,000 - $125,000 USD Annually

Position Summary

Baudouin America is seeking an experienced Field Service Engineer to support our industrial power generation customers across the U.S. Midwest. This role focuses on the commissioning, maintenance, and technical support of Baudouin industrial diesel engines, ensuring reliable performance in demanding applications such as standby, prime, and continuous power systems.

The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on technical expertise with large-bore diesel engines, an analytical approach to troubleshooting, and a passion for customer support in dynamic field environments.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer sponsorship. This role requires 30–40% regional travel.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform commissioning, maintenance, and repair services for Baudouin industrial diesel engines and associated systems.

• Troubleshoot and diagnose complex mechanical, electrical, and control-related engine issues using diagnostic tools and software.

• Conduct periodic inspections and preventive maintenance to ensure optimal engine performance and uptime.

• Support OEM partners, distributors, and end-users with on-site technical solutions and recommendations.

• Prepare accurate service documentation including reports, parts requirements, and corrective actions.

• Coordinate warranty inspections, root cause analyses, and feedback with technical and factory teams.

• Provide training and guidance to customers and service partners on engine operation and maintenance best practices.

• Ensure compliance with all Baudouin safety, environmental, and quality standards during field operations.

• Travel regionally (30–40%), with occasional national assignments as required.

• Spanish–English bilingual proficiency preferred

Qualifications

Education Experience

• Associate or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Diesel Technology, or equivalent technical field.

• Minimum 3–5 years of field service experience with large industrial or power generation diesel engines.

• Experience with CAT, Wärtsilä, Cummins, MTU, or MAN engines highly preferred.

• Working knowledge of electronic control systems, fuel systems, turbochargers, and cooling systems.

Technical Competencies

• Proficient with electronic diagnostic tools and engine control interfaces.

• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting ability.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and service manuals.

Professional Attributes

• Customer-focused approach with strong communication and reporting skills.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in field environments.

• High sense of responsibility, professionalism, and commitment to safety.

Additional Requirements

• Must be authorized to work in the United States.

• Valid U.S. driver’s license and clean driving record.

• Ability to travel extensively within Illinois and Wisconsin, with flexibility for other regions as needed.

What We Offer

• Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and 401(k).

• Company-provided laptop, and diagnostic tools.

• Continuous technical training and certification opportunities.

• A collaborative environment within a globally respected engine manufacturer.

About Baudouin

Founded in 1918, Baudouin designs and manufactures high-performance diesel engines for marine and power generation applications worldwide. As part of the Weichai Group, Baudouin combines over a century of European engineering excellence with advanced global support. Baudouin America delivers reliable power solutions and dedicated service support across North America.

About Weichai

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Weifang, China, Weichai is a global industrial power-systems group under Shandong Heavy Industry. It operates across engines, transmissions, axles, commercial vehicles, construction and agricultural machinery, marine/off-highway systems, and emerging new-energy powertrains. The group serves over 150 countries with 100,000 + employees and annual revenue exceeding RMB 300 billion (~US$40 billion).
